design: A fresh device-based UI built from painted cast-steel instrument housings, Bakelite push-keys, recessed dark counter windows and enamel label plates. Native game data, alpha masks, glyphs and input bindings are retained.
artwork_mode: Built-in image_gen; source prompts in tools/ui_devices/prompts.json
scenario_design: Vanilla 232x211 bookmark mounts and selected glow, inset original pictures, centered native headings and native cornered paper frame, mixed with the existing Endsieg outer frame and brown footer controls.
country_design: Native portrait and flag mounts with their selected glow, native title mount and riveted information/idea/focus panels, original paper graded to newspaper stock; Endsieg outer frame and brown filter/footer controls retained.
